findings.evidence: Mathlib/GroupTheory/QuotientGroup/Basic.lean:466-486 defines `QuotientGroup.mulEquivPiModRangePowMonoidHom` with the same componentwise map; TauCeti/Algebra/Group/ElementaryTwoQuotient.lean:266-274 already supplies `elementaryTwoQuotientEquivSquareQuotient` for the representation change.
findings.fix: Construct it by transporting `QuotientGroup.mulEquivPiModRangePowMonoidHom (fun i => G i) 2` (or its additive generated version) through `elementaryTwoQuotientEquivSquareQuotient`, then add the `ZMod 2` linear structure wrapper.
findings.issue: `elementaryTwoQuotientPiLinearEquiv` manually rebuilds the indexed product quotient equivalence already provided by Mathlib for quotients by `powMonoidHom n` ranges.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/GroupTheory/QuotientGroup/Basic.lean:74-89 provides `QuotientAddGroup.prodEquiv`/`prodAddEquiv`; Mathlib/GroupTheory/QuotientGroup/Basic.lean:466-486 provides the general product-over-index version for power-map ranges.
findings.fix: Derive the binary equivalence from the fixed pi equivalence with `ι = Fin 2`, or from `QuotientAddGroup.prodAddEquiv` plus the square-subgroup identification, rather than reproving inverse laws by hand.
findings.issue: `elementaryTwoQuotientProdLinearEquiv` is the binary instance of the same product quotient construction and duplicates the same projection/inclusion proof.

summary: The product/pi quotient equivalences reprove existing Mathlib quotient-by-powers product API instead of transporting it to TauCeti's `ElementaryTwoQuotient` wrapper.
